Aid poured in, but rebuilding was slow, slowed by politics and a fuel blockade on the Indian border later that year. The Kasthamandap was rebuilt and reopened in April 2022, part of a long effort to restore the valley’s World Heritage monuments.
story.zh:
2015年4月25日星期六临近中午，印度板块沿着一条约150公里长的断层在喜马拉雅山下猛然错动。震中在廓尔喀县巴尔帕克附近，那里正是统一尼泊尔的王朝的故乡，但破裂向东延伸到加德满都谷地之下，不到一分钟就把城市抬升了约一米。

山区村庄的石砌和泥砖房屋几乎全部倒塌；在加德满都，周六游人众多的九层达拉哈拉塔轰然倒塌，约180人遇难，城市名称由来的木构亭阁“卡斯塔曼达普”化为瓦砾。珠峰上一场雪崩横扫大本营，至少19人遇难。5月12日的一次强余震又增加了伤亡。

援助源源而来，但重建进展缓慢，受到政治纷争和同年晚些时候印度边境燃料封锁的拖累。“卡斯塔曼达普”经重建，于2022年4月重新开放，这是修复谷地世界遗产古迹这一漫长工作的一部分。

name.en: Chandrayaan-3 lands near the Moon’s south pole
name.zh: 月船3号在月球南极附近着陆

summary.en: Launched from Sriharikota on 14 July 2023, the Indian Space Research Organisation’s Vikram lander touched down on 23 August at about 69°S, then the closest any spacecraft had landed to the lunar south pole. India became the fourth country to soft-land on the Moon; the Pragyan rover confirmed sulphur in the soil.
summary.zh: 印度空间研究组织的“维克拉姆”着陆器于2023年7月14日从斯里哈里科塔发射，8月23日在约南纬69度处着陆，是当时着陆点最接近月球南极的航天器。印度成为第四个实现月球软着陆的国家；“智慧”号月球车证实了月壤中含有硫。

note: Marker at the launch site, the Satish Dhawan Space Centre.

summary.en: Student protests against quotas in government jobs grew, after a lethal crackdown, into a mass uprising against Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Some 1,400 people were killed, according to the UN; on 5 August 2024 Hasina fled to India, and the Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus led an interim government.
summary.zh: 学生反对政府职位配额制度的抗议在遭到血腥镇压后，演变为反对总理谢赫·哈西娜的大规模起义。据联合国统计约1,400人遇难；2024年8月5日哈西娜出逃印度，诺贝尔奖得主穆罕默德·尤努斯领导临时政府。

sources.title: UN OHCHR: Fact-Finding Report on Human Rights Violations and Abuses related to the Protests of July and August 2024 in Bangladesh (Feb. 2025)

note: The death toll follows the OHCHR estimate of up to 1,400; Bangladeshi government figures differ.

story.en:
In June 2024 the High Court restored a quota that reserved 30 per cent of government jobs for descendants of the 1971 freedom fighters, a system students saw as favouring supporters of the ruling Awami League. Protests spread across the universities. When Sheikh Hasina appeared to compare the protesters to razakars, the collaborators of 1971, students answered with mocking slogans, and the ruling party’s student wing and police attacked them.

On 16 July a student in Rangpur, Abu Sayed, was filmed standing with arms outstretched as police shot him; the video spread nationwide. The government cut the internet, imposed a curfew and ordered troops onto the streets. The Supreme Court cut the quota, but by then the demand had become Hasina’s resignation.

On 5 August hundreds of thousands marched on Dhaka. The army refused to fire, and Hasina, in power since 2009, fled by helicopter to India. Crowds stormed her residence. Three days later Muhammad Yunus returned from Paris to head an interim government promising reforms and elections.
story.zh:
2024年6月，高等法院恢复了为1971年自由战士后代保留30%政府职位的配额制度，学生们认为这一制度偏袒执政的人民联盟支持者。抗议蔓延到各大学。当谢赫·哈西娜似乎把抗议者比作1971年的通敌者“拉扎卡尔”时，学生们以嘲讽的口号回应，执政党的学生组织和警察随即对他们大打出手。

7月16日，朗布尔的学生阿布·赛义德张开双臂站在警察面前被枪杀，视频传遍全国。政府切断互联网，实行宵禁，并命令军队上街。最高法院削减了配额，但此时诉求已变成要求哈西娜下台。

8月5日，数十万人向达卡进发。军队拒绝开枪，自2009年起执政的哈西娜乘直升机逃往印度，人群冲进了她的官邸。三天后穆罕默德·尤努斯从巴黎回国，领导承诺改革和选举的临时政府。

name.zh: 帕罗虎穴寺（塔克桑寺）创建

summary.en: Gyalse Tenzin Rabgye, ruler of the Drukpa state, built a temple complex on a cliff some 900 metres above the Paro valley, around the cave where, by legend, Padmasambhava meditated after flying there on a tigress. Gutted by fire in 1998, it was rebuilt by 2005.
summary.zh: 竹巴政权的统治者杰赛·丹增饶杰在高出帕罗河谷约900米的悬崖上修建了这座寺院建筑群，环绕着一处山洞；相传莲花生大师骑雌虎飞抵此地并在洞中修行。寺院1998年毁于大火，2005年前修复。

sources.title: John Ardussi, “Gyalse Tenzin Rabgye and the Founding of Taktsang Lhakhang”, Journal of Bhutan Studies 1 (1999)
Paro Dzongkhag Administration: Taktshang (Tiger Nest) Monastery
Karma Phuntsho, The History of Bhutan (2013)

note: Construction ran 1692–1694 (Ardussi). The Padmasambhava story is legend; the fire was in April 1998.

name.en: Duar War and Treaty of Sinchula
name.zh: 杜阿尔战争与辛楚拉条约

summary.en: After the envoy Ashley Eden was humiliated at Punakha, British India invaded Bhutan’s southern foothills. Bhutanese troops retook the fort of Dewangiri, but by the Treaty of Sinchula (11 November 1865) Bhutan ceded the fertile Bengal and Assam Duars in return for an annual subsidy of up to 50,000 rupees.
summary.zh: 英国特使阿什利·伊登在普那卡受辱后，英属印度出兵不丹南部山麓。不丹军队一度夺回德旺吉里要塞，但根据1865年11月11日的《辛楚拉条约》，不丹割让富庶的孟加拉和阿萨姆杜阿尔地区，换取每年最多五万卢比的补贴。

sources.title: Karma Phuntsho, The History of Bhutan (2013)

note: Marker at Dewangiri (Deothang), the war’s main fighting in the east. Eden’s mission is dated 1863–64 in different accounts.

name.en: Ugyen Wangchuck elected first king of Bhutan
name.zh: 乌颜·旺楚克被推举为不丹首任国王

summary.en: An assembly of monks, officials and leading families at Punakha Dzong chose Ugyen Wangchuck, the Trongsa Penlop who had ended Bhutan’s civil wars, as hereditary Druk Gyalpo, replacing the dual system of the Zhabdrung era. The date, 17 December, is Bhutan’s National Day.
summary.zh: 僧团、官员和名门代表在普那卡宗堡集会，推举结束了不丹内战的通萨本洛乌颜·旺楚克为世袭的“龙王”（竹杰波），取代了夏仲时代的政教二元体制。12月17日由此成为不丹国庆日。

sources.title: Michael Aris, The Raven Crown: The Origins of Buddhist Monarchy in Bhutan (1994)

note: No Wikidata item covers the 1907 election as an event (checked 2026-11); Q796782 is the House of Wangchuck itself.

name.zh: 不丹成为君主立宪制国家

summary.en: At the initiative of King Jigme Singye Wangchuck, who abdicated in 2006, Bhutan held its first National Assembly elections in March 2008 and adopted a written constitution on 18 July 2008, under which parliament, followed by a national referendum, can force the king to abdicate, and the king must step down at 65.
summary.zh: 在2006年退位的国王吉格梅·辛格·旺楚克推动下，不丹于2008年3月举行首次国民议会选举，并于2008年7月18日通过成文宪法。根据宪法，议会表决并经全民公投可迫使国王退位，国王年满65岁须让位。

sources.title: The Constitution of the Kingdom of Bhutan (2008), Article 2
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Bhutan, Government and society
Wikidata Q864684: 2008 Bhutanese National Assembly election

note: QID is the Constitution; the record date is its adoption. The National Assembly election was held on 24 March 2008.

name.en: Muhammad Thakurufaanu ends Portuguese rule in the Maldives
name.zh: 穆罕默德·塔库鲁法努结束葡萄牙在马尔代夫的统治

summary.en: The Portuguese had seized Malé in 1558, killing Sultan Ali VI. Muhammad Thakurufaanu of Utheemu and his brothers waged years of raids from their boat Kalhuohfummi and in 1573 killed the governor, Andiri Andirin, in Malé. Thakurufaanu became sultan; the victory is marked as the Maldives’ National Day.
summary.zh: 1558年葡萄牙人攻占马累，杀死苏丹阿里六世。乌提姆岛的穆罕默德·塔库鲁法努与兄弟们驾驶“卡卢奥夫米”号船多年袭扰，1573年在马累击杀葡萄牙总督安迪里·安迪林。塔库鲁法努随后成为苏丹，这场胜利被定为马尔代夫国庆日。

sources.title: Clarence Maloney, People of the Maldive Islands (1980)

note: The details of the guerrilla war come mostly from Maldivian tradition and later chronicles. National Day falls on 1 Rabi al-Awwal, the Hijri date of the victory, so its Gregorian date moves each year. No Wikidata item covers the event itself (checked 2026-11).

name.zh: 马累星期五清真寺（胡库鲁清真寺）建成

summary.en: Sultan Ibrahim Iskandar I rebuilt the main mosque of Malé in carved coral stone, with lacquered and carved wooden interiors and Arabic inscriptions. It is the finest of the Maldives’ coral-stone mosques, placed on UNESCO’s tentative World Heritage list in 2008 (as part of a joint entry from 2013).
summary.zh: 苏丹易卜拉欣·伊斯坎达尔一世用雕琢的珊瑚石重建了马累的主清真寺，内部饰有漆绘木雕和阿拉伯文铭刻。它是马尔代夫珊瑚石清真寺中最精美的一座，2008年列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产预备名录（2013年起并入“马尔代夫珊瑚石清真寺”联合条目）。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Tentative Lists: Coral Stone Mosques of Maldives (2013)

note: Sources date the rebuilding 1656–1658; 1658 follows Wikidata and most guides.

summary.en: In Colombo, Prime Minister Ibrahim Nasir, for the sultan, and the British envoy Sir Michael Walker signed an agreement ending the British protectorate of 1887. The Maldives joined the United Nations that September; Britain kept its air base on Gan until 1976, and a referendum made the country a republic in 1968.
summary.zh: 在科伦坡，首相易卜拉欣·纳西尔代表苏丹与英国代表迈克尔·沃克爵士签署协议，结束了始于1887年的英国保护关系。马尔代夫同年9月加入联合国；英国在甘岛的空军基地保留到1976年，1968年公投后马尔代夫改行共和。

sources.title: Maldives Independent: Timeline – Story of Independence

note: Signed at the British High Commissioner’s residence in Colombo; marker at Malé.

name.en: Coup attempt in the Maldives and Operation Cactus
name.zh: 马尔代夫未遂政变与“仙人掌行动”

summary.en: Mercenaries of the Sri Lankan Tamil group PLOTE, hired by the Maldivian businessman Abdullah Luthufi, landed in Malé to overthrow President Maumoon Abdul Gayoom. At his request India flew paratroopers to Hulhulé within hours; the Indian navy caught the fleeing mercenaries and their hostages at sea. About 19 people were killed.
summary.zh: 受马尔代夫商人阿卜杜拉·卢图菲雇用，斯里兰卡泰米尔武装“泰米尔伊拉姆人民解放组织”的雇佣兵在马累登陆，企图推翻总统穆蒙·阿卜杜勒·加尧姆。应其请求，印度在数小时内空运伞兵至胡鲁勒岛；印度海军在海上截获了挟持人质出逃的雇佣兵。约19人死亡。

note: Estimates of the mercenary force range from about 80 to 200. Marker at Hulhulé airport, where the Indian paratroopers landed.
